UPESSC UP Principal Inter Level Online Form 2026 (1475 Posts) – Full Details

Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC) has released the notification for the post of Principal Intermediate Level. This recruitment has been issued for 1475 posts. Online applying process for UPESSC UP Principal Inter Level Recruitment 2026 has started from 23 October 2026 & the candidates can apply till 22 November 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for UPESSC UP Principal Inter Level Recruitment 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 23 October 2026
  • Last Date : 22 November 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 22 November 2026
  • Correction Date : 25 November 2026
  • Exam Date : 07 January 2027
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 2000/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 2000/-
  • PH : Rs. 2000/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

  • Apply Online
